text:
arjun: heads up — noticed a ~12% p99 token latency bump on the MQA line after yesterday's paged-KV layout change in prod. Dumping profiler summary here, looks correlated with kernel selection shifts.

perf-bot: automated perf snapshot:
```
before: model=mqa-3b, p50=40ms, p95=120ms, p99=240ms, tokens/s=180
after:  p50=42ms, p95=130ms, p99=268ms, tokens/s=160
regression: p99 +11.7%
hot path: kernel_picker -> choose_fallback_dense for many batches
```

mei: can you paste the kernel-picker debug log? iirc the selector uses architecture thresholds + blocksz heuristics, maybe the layout change changed effective block fragmentation.

arjun: log snippet (sanitized):
```
[kernel-picker] model=mqa-3b, device=A100, seqlen=1024, kv_page_block=256, kv_frag_pct=18
chosen_kernel: fallback_dense (score=0.72) vs paged_attn_v2 (score=0.68)
reason: shared_mem_avail < threshold_on_device(T4/A100) -> lower rank for paged_attn_v2
```

sam: ran targeted microbench on staging:
- A100: blocksz=256 -> paged_attn_v2 chosen, p99=220ms
- T4:  blocksz=256 -> fallback_dense chosen, p99=260ms
Note: after layout change kv_frag_pct increased from ~6% -> ~18% for some shards. That seems to bump the effective seqlen used in scoring.

lina: quick hypothesis: the picker uses (seqlen + kv_frag_effect) to pick kernels; layout change increased kv_frag_effect and pushed score over the dense threshold for some devices. Two quick options: tweak scoring to discount fragmentation by device, or add a device-specific hysteresis to prefer paged_attn when blocksz >= 128.

mei: micro numbers I ran locally (loop=500 queries):
```
A100 paged_attn_v2 p99=218ms, tokens/s=182
T4 fallback_dense   p99=259ms, tokens/s=150
canary tweak: force_paged_preference_on_T4 -> p99=233ms, tokens/s=168 (cost +2%)
```

sam: opened a small canary with the "paged-prefer" flag on 5% of traffic for mqa-3b. Early signals (1h): p99 back to baseline on canary, but overall cost egress up ~1.8% on that cohort. No errors.

arjun: proposed short runbook:
1) keep paged-KV layout change (it improves throughput for longer contexts)
2) roll kernel-picker tweak (device-specific preference for blocksz>=128) to 20% canary now
3) add per-request telemetry: kernel_pick, kv_frag_pct, chosen_blocksz to tracing span
4) follow-up: autotune job to recompute device thresholds weekly using perf harness

lina: i'll own the rollout schedule and rollback criteria. rollback if p99 > baseline +5% or error rate increases >0.1%.

mei: i'll add the tracing fields and a unit test to ensure picker doesn't flip choices when kv_frag_pct fluctuates <5%.

sam: i'll wire a grafana panel: kernel_picks_by_device, avg_kv_frag, p99_by_cohort. will post link once done.

perf-bot: created perf-issue #4321 and uploaded flamegraphs and the raw profiler. Link: https://phabricator/reviews/PR-4321 (bot note: attach logs if you need stack traces) :gear:

arjun: thanks team — main action owners: lina (rollout), mei (telemetry + tests), sam (dashboards), i'll draft the PR for the picker heuristic tweak and include microbench scripts. ping me for review. :thumbsup:

lina: small note — let's gate the tweak behind a feature flag + admitter check (only MQA models for now). avoids accidental impact on GQA flows.

arjun: agreed. will include gating.

sam: posting microbench command I used:
```
./bench --model mqa-3b --device T4 --kv-page-block 256 --iters 500 --force-picker-debug > pick.log
```

mei: i'll add a regression test that runs the bench with different kv_frag_pct values and asserts chosen_kernel stability for small frag deltas.

arjun: great. closing the loop in a few hours after 20% canary run.
